title: RangeSWA: Training-Free Length Extrapolation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.42084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models show promising potential in text generation tasks, but are prone to problems such as text repetition, semantic drift, and generation quality degradation when the generation length exceeds the training length. To address these challenges, we propose RangeSWA, a training-free length extrapolation method. The method combines local sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, and dynamic content retrieval to preserve local details and support long-range context access. In addition, generation degradation caused by length extrapolation is mitigated through positional remapping, conditioning attention correction, and denoising-stage-adaptive window scheduling. We conducted experiments on multiple continuous diffusion language models, and the results show that RangeSWA can effectively reduce generative perplexity and text repetition rates in long-text generation.

translated_title: RangeSWA：面向连续扩散语言模型的无训练长度外推方法
translated_abstract: 连续扩散语言模型在文本生成任务中展现出可观的潜力，但当生成长度超过训练长度时，容易出现文本重复、语义漂移和生成质量下降等问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RangeSWA，一种无需训练的长度外推方法。该方法结合了局部滑动窗口注意力、远程块摘要和动态内容检索，以保留局部细节并支持长程上下文访问。此外，通过位置重映射、条件注意力校正以及适应去噪阶段的窗口调度，缓解了由长度外推引起的生成质量退化。我们在多个连续扩散语言模型上进行了实验，结果表明RangeSWA能够有效降低长文本生成中的生成困惑度和文本重复率。
tldr: RangeSWA是一种无需训练的长度外推方法，通过滑动窗口注意力、远程块摘要、动态内容检索以及位置重映射等技术，使连续扩散语言模型在超出训练长度生成文本时仍能保持质量，有效降低生成困惑度和文本重复率。
en_tdlr: RangeSWA is a training-free length extrapolation method that combines sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, dynamic content retrieval, and positional remapping, enabling continuous diffusion language models to generate high-quality text beyond their training length while reducing perplexity and repetition.
